name: B-spline Wavelet Compression
definition: A preprocessing method using B-spline wavelets to compute wavelet coefficients and positions. Coefficients are arranged with decreasing importance, then compressed with delta encoding, quantization, run-length, and Huffman coding.
summary: B-spline Wavelet Compression decomposes volumetric data using B-spline basis functions to avoid the over- and undershoots of standard subdivision wavelets.
